name: PHP
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Runs a PHP website or app, such as a Laravel site or a bot, from your files or a Git repository. Websites are served by FrankenPHP; Composer packages are installed when composer.json changes. PHP settings go in .ini files in the php.d folder.
startup: if [ -d .git ] && [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = "1" ]; then git pull --ff-only || echo "git pull failed: starting what is here"; fi; deps() { (php -r "echo PHP_VERSION;"; cat composer.json composer.lock 2>/dev/null) | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1; }; if [ -f composer.json ] && [ "$(deps)" != "$(cat vendor/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-progress || { echo "Composer couldn't install the packages in composer.json."; exit 1; }; deps > vendor/.raptor-installed; fi; if [ "{{PHP_MODE}}" = "script" ]; then exec php "{{MAIN_FILE}}" {{PHP_ARGS}}; fi; if [ ! -d "{{WEB_ROOT}}" ]; then echo "The web root ({{WEB_ROOT}}) isn't there: upload your site into it, or change Web root."; exit 1; fi; exec frankenphp php-server --listen 0.0.0.0:{{SERVER_PORT}} --root "{{WEB_ROOT}}"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# PHP: clones the app's Git repository, if one is set. Files already in the
# server's folder are never deleted or overwritten; an empty folder gets a
# placeholder page in public/ to show the server works.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

clone() {
    local url="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
    case "$url" in *.git) ;; *) url="$url.git" ;; esac
    if [ -n "${GIT_USERNAME:-}" ] && [ -n "${GIT_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
        url="https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_TOKEN}@${url#https://}"
    fi
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        echo "The repository is already here: pulling the latest changes."
        git pull --ff-only
    elif [ -n "$(ls -A)" ]; then
        echo "The folder already has files and isn't a Git repository, so nothing was cloned."
    else
        GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git clone --depth 1 ${GIT_BRANCH:+--branch "$GIT_BRANCH"} "$url" . || {
            echo "The repository couldn't be cloned: check its address, and the username and access token for a private one."
            exit 1
        }
    fi
}

if [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS:-}" ]; then
    clone
elif [ -z "$(ls -A)" ]; then
    mkdir -p public
    cat > public/index.php <<'EOF'
<?php
// A placeholder: upload your site into this folder (public/), or set a Git repository and reinstall.
echo "PHP " . PHP_VERSION . " is running. Upload your site into the public folder.";
EOF
    echo "No Git repository set: upload your site into public/, then start the server."
else
    echo "No Git repository set: starting the files that are here."
fi
mkdir -p php.d
echo "Installed."

variables.name: App type
variables.description: website serves the web root on the server's port, sending paths that aren't files to its index.php; script runs the main file, such as a bot or a worker.

variables.name: Web root
variables.description: The folder the website is served from, such as public or web; its index.php handles requests.

variables.name: Main file
variables.description: The file a script app starts with, such as bot.php or bin/worker.php.

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: An https link to the app's repository, cloned when the server is installed. Leave it empty to upload the files yourself.

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description: The branch to clone. Empty uses the repository's default branch.

variables.name: Git username
variables.description: Your username on the Git host, for a private repository.

variables.name: Git access token
variables.description: An access token that can read the private repository.

variables.name: Pull updates at start
variables.description: Pull the repository's latest changes every time the server starts.

variables.name: Arguments
variables.description: Arguments passed to a script app.
